environment.title: Scripts and environment variables
environment.intro: Installs tools for rooms and project dependencies when task code is prepared. Rooms in the project share this setup; General uses the base environment and helps fix environment problems
environment.setupHint: Installs tools such as Python and Node. Runs once per project on each machine, and again when a new setup is applied
environment.startupHint: Runs each time a task's working directory is created or reopened, installing that branch's dependencies
environment.how1: Cloud and your own devices use the same scripts, so the machine must support their commands
environment.how2: The setup script runs in the room directory and the startup script in the task's code directory. Both use Bash, each for at most 30 minutes, with the machine's current permissions. Environment variables go to both scripts and the AI teammate; an export in a script doesn't carry to the next step. Tools can be installed to $HOME/.local/bin
environment.how3: For the setup script, $HOME is this project's shared tool directory on the machine, so tools are installed once and later rooms use them. The startup script and the AI teammate have each room's own $HOME, so don't write anything room-specific in the setup script
environment.varsHint: Project members and AI teammates can see these values. Don't store passwords or API keys here
environment.saveNote: Saving affects only new rooms; existing rooms keep their setup
environment.logNote: Only the last 32 KB of log is shown; the full log is in the room's $HOME
environment.recoveryRequested: Handed to the AI teammate in General to check; follow it in General
environment.recoveryRetrying: The AI teammate in General fixed the setup and is restarting
environment.recoveryNeedsHelp: Automatic repair couldn't recover the environment; see what help is needed in General
environment.roomNote: Files in the room are kept. A room that is running applies the setup after the current run ends
